speaker: john_heminges
text: On again. Same doors as yesterday's afternoon. I am not opening a book at two o'clock.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Then I will be what I was. No new line. Do not look at me as if I had grown one.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not looking at you for a new line. I am on, and the morning's parcel is not this scene.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Good. Play it, and come off. The day is not finished when the play is.

speaker: will_kemp
text: You hear the man. Come off clean. I intend to.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then we come off clean. God give you the house.

speaker: john_heminges
text: And you. Keep the afternoon the afternoon.
